source_evidence.detail: Fixture presents the actual NSAlert with beginSheetModal(for:completionHandler:), matching the production presentation API.
The actual NSAlert OK button is invoked synchronously with performClick(nil); the immediately following returned-phase marker is absent.
Completion guards alert identity and owner retirement; then ends/orders out the sheet and awaits detachment before clearing exportError/model.hasSheet.

statistics_artifact.stack_evidence: All 174 sampled main-thread stacks show NSApplication.run waiting for native events. No active performClick, NSAlert completion, endSheet, or waitForSheet frame appears. An auxiliary HIServices thread has the symbol SOME_OTHER_THREAD_SWALLOWED_AT_LEAST_ONE_EXCEPTION; this symbol alone does not identify an exception or its source.
statistics_artifact.diagnostic_limit: Lost progress at native OK dispatch is proven. The evidence does not distinguish a fixture/AppKit action-dispatch failure from a production error-sheet completion problem. No production root-cause claim or sheet-retirement fix is justified yet.
statistics_artifact.next_bounded_diagnosis: Add receiver-only failure diagnostics around native button target/action/state and error-completion entry/endSheet/settlement, plus bounded exception observation; recheck only ownership/system Git before choosing a repair. Keep the production ownership assertions intact.
